title: Chhattisgarh Passes 'Chhattisgarh Ease of Doing Business Act 2026'
summary: First Indian state to introduce a comprehensive risk-based and trust-based business permission system.

blocks.content: First Indian state to introduce a comprehensive risk-based and trust-based business permission system.

items: Risk-Based Approvals: Replaces uniform approvals with risk-based self-certification for low-risk businesses and deemed approvals for larger units.
Initial Scope: Encompasses 43 services across 8 state government departments.
